description: Scripted judge replies for the stub suites. The StubJudgeServer reads the STATE, RESPONSE, CLAIM and TARGET sections of the last user message; a reply answers a call when every section its match names is equal, and exactly one reply must answer, in an OpenAI chat-completions envelope. A call no reply (or more than one) answers gets HTTP 404, which fails the test. The judge's answer is incidental in these suites: they test the runner, the reports, the traces and that each call carries the right facts, not the model.

match.state: The library closes at 18:00 on weekdays.
match.claim: The reply is consistent with the library's weekday opening hours.

reply.reasoning: It is 19:30 on a weekday, after the 18:00 closing time.

match.state: The library is closed all day on Sundays.
match.claim: The reply is consistent with the library's Sunday hours.

reply.reasoning: The library is closed all day on Sundays.

match.state: The museum is free on the first Sunday of every month.
match.claim: The reply is consistent with the museum's free-entry rule.

reply.reasoning: Entry is free on the first Sunday of the month, as the reply says.

match.state: King Street has one traffic light.
match.claim: The reply says the traffic light turned green.

reply.reasoning: The reply says the light turned red.

match.response: I bought three apples and nothing else.

reply.reasoning: The reply says three apples were bought.

match.state: The library closes at 18:00 on weekdays.
match.target: the day of the week it is

reply.reasoning: The reply says it is a Tuesday.
The reply hedges between two and three, so strict mode gives no value.

match.state:
Meeting room Lyra is free all afternoon.
Meeting room Vega is booked all afternoon.
match.response: Good news — you can have Orion at 14:30.
match.claim: The reply only offers a room that the known schedule shows is free at the requested time.

reply.reasoning: Orion is not in the known schedule.

match.state:
Meeting room Lyra is free all afternoon.
Meeting room Vega is booked all afternoon.
match.response: Lyra is free at 14:30 — it's yours.
match.claim: The reply only offers a room that the known schedule shows is free at the requested time.

match.state:
Meeting room Lyra is free all afternoon.
Meeting room Vega is booked all afternoon.
Meeting room Orion is free all afternoon.
match.response: Good news — you can have Orion at 14:30.
match.claim: The reply only offers a room that the known schedule shows is free at the requested time.

reply.reasoning: Orion is now known to be free all afternoon.
